title: Coromandel Family Deals
meta_desc: Discover the best family deals in Coromandel, including activity discounts, campervan hires, and travel insurance.
intro: The Coromandel Peninsula is a top destination for families, with its stunning beaches, hot water springs, and exciting activities. To make the most of your trip, we've rounded up the best current deals and discounts. From activity discounts to campervan hires, we've got you covered.

sections.heading: Best-Value Activities
sections.body:
Some of the best-value activities in Coromandel include visiting Hot Water Beach, where you can dig your own hot pool in the sand, and exploring the stunning Cathedral Cove. The Driving Creek Railway and Gold Mine Experience in Thames are also highly recommended. These activities offer a great balance of fun, education, and value for money.

For a more budget-friendly option, consider visiting Hahei Beach, one of New Zealand's most beautiful beaches, which is free to access. The Whitianga waterfront and beach are also worth exploring, with plenty of free activities and stunning views.
list: Cathedral Cove: free, but parking costs $10-$20

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips
sections.body:
To make the most of your Coromandel holiday, consider the following money-saving tips. Book your activities and accommodation in advance to secure the best prices. Look for package deals that include multiple activities or services, which can often be cheaper than booking individually.

Additionally, consider visiting during the shoulder season, when prices are lower, or taking advantage of free activities like visiting the beach or going for a hike. You can also save money by cooking your own meals instead of eating out, and by avoiding peak season prices.
list: Book in advance to secure the best prices
Look for package deals and discounts
Visit during the shoulder season for lower prices
Cook your own meals to save money

sections.heading: When to Book
sections.body:
To get the best prices, it's recommended to book your Coromandel holiday at least 2-3 months in advance. This will give you access to the best deals and discounts, and ensure that you can secure your preferred accommodation and activities.

Keep an eye on the Bookme.co.nz website for activity discounts, and sign up for their newsletter to stay informed about upcoming deals. You can also set up price alerts with Discover Cars to notify you when campervan prices drop.
